thread:
elaine: p99 on model-4 spiked to ~820ms on canary this morning, started around 02:10 UTC. looks correlated with sessions that have long prompts (~6k tokens) + inline tool calls.
vikram: do we have kv eviction logs around that window? could be warmup misses + eviction thrash.
elaine: uploading a quick flame: https://internal.s3/redwood/prof/2001123456/flame.svg — main hotspots are kv_cache::fetch -> recompile_kernel -> attention_fallback.
samir: hmm the flame shows repeated rehydrate for the same session id, like eviction tag mismatch / double-alloc. sample from logs: `kv_eviction=age_based candidate=shard-17 session=abcd123` repeated ~6x.
vikram: can you run the kv stats endpoint (admin) and paste a snippet? want hot-key counts / tombstones.
elaine: posted /admin/kv-stats output:
```
hot_keys: 12
evict_rate: 0.8/s
rehydrate_fail: 23
avg_kv_latency_ms: 14
```
Most rehydrate_fail lines map to requests that also did tool-calls mid-generation.
anya: i also noticed kernel-selector flipping to the slow path when seq_len > 2048 *and* tool-arg parsing is enabled. that combo disables a fused-attn path, so you get both kv churn and slower kernels.
samir: repro script for local bench if useful:
```
# simulate long prompt + tool call loop
python bench_toolloop.py --tokens 6000 --calls 3 --sleep 0.05
# observe repeated kv misses and kernel_switch_count increments
```
This reproduces the p99 bump reliably.
elaine: propose short-term mitigations: bump kv cache size on canary and set sticky sessions for routes that enable tools (avoid reassigning session shards). long-term: fix eviction-age calculation and add a kernel-choice cache keyed by (model, seq_bucket, tool_flag).
vikram: :thumbsup: i'll patch the eviction threshold to 2x for canary and run a canary-only experiment. samir, can you add a unit test for eviction tag comparison?
samir: on it. i'll also add metrics: `kv_rehydrate_latency_p99` and `kernel_switch_count` so we can alert if switching spikes.
deploy-bot: canary:config updated by vikram — kv_evict_threshold 0.8 -> 1.6; rollout triggered to canary (instances=12).
elaine: thanks — watching p95/p99 dashboards now, will report back in 30m.
